query: Find VPs of engineering at Stripe.
expected_behavior: Happy path: resolve 'Stripe' to an org id with the pipeline's resolve command first, then run a plan (company + VP seniority 300, company + resolved title ids) through the pipeline, default 25 per page. It must not pass the raw company name as a title or keyword, and must not install or call an MCP.

query: I just ran a sales nav search for 'staff engineers at Anthropic' and got back 187 leads. Narrow it to just the Bay Area.
expected_behavior: Refining filters is a new query: continue the run with a plan file whose new id adds company + geography_ids (Bay Area 90000084). It must not filter the loaded leads by hand and must not start an unrelated run.

query: Show me the next 25 leads from the Stripe run we just did.
expected_behavior: Paging is the same query with start_offset set to its next_start_offset, added to the run as a new plan id and continued. It must not re-resolve the company or start a new run.

query: Find VPs at Stripe. (This chat has no set selected.)
expected_behavior: Without POWERPACKS_DEFAULT_SET_ID the pipeline searches through the user's own LinkedIn session. The plan runs as usual, the output says backend local, and enrichment and mutual URL steps record that they were skipped. The agent must not ask the user which backend, must not install an MCP, and must mention that results are the user's own 2nd degree.

query: For the Brookfield Sales Nav run we just loaded, show me people with real estate exposure.
expected_behavior: Qualitative refinement over an already-loaded run scores the local leads artifact (lead scoring over the persisted leads file, producing a matches output) — it must not launch a fresh upstream Sales Nav search or create a new artifact for what is a local re-ranking question.

query: Who is on the investment team or an investor in Dartmouth endowment?
expected_behavior: Robust-recall path: resolve Dartmouth to the parent organization, build a plan (parent + finance function 10, one or two parent + investment keyword queries, past-company variant last) run through the pipeline, read the per-query summaries, then score with strict criteria that give 0 to trustees, accounting, faculty and generic staff. A single keyword-only query, or stopping because generic parent staff loaded, fails this case.

query: Lead 12345 has mutual_member_ids [67890, 11111, 22222] from a previous search. Show me their LinkedIn URLs.
expected_behavior: With a set, the pipeline resolves mutual member ids to LinkedIn URLs itself through the cache layers (free) as part of the run; the agent reads exports/mutuals.csv. It must not request paid external resolution unless the user asks, and must not use profile enrichment for a URL lookup.

query: Who do we know at Stripe? (The people search just found 2.)
expected_behavior: The network was searched first and came back thin, so the next step is the Sales Navigator search for Stripe in the same chat, presented as people outside the network with mutual counts. It must not re-run the internal search, must not have gone to Sales Nav before the internal search, and must not ask the user which to use.
